People: John Charles Frémont (author, Wikidata Q169011), died 1890. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Frémont, John Charles, 1813-1890") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The exploring expedition to the Rocky Mountains, Oregon and California, Buffalo : Derby, 1852, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/exploringfremont00frrich. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 79%, 93%, 72% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of John Charles Frémont, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
